rules.title: Owner move-in eviction relocation assistance (2026 adjustment)
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance
rules.quote: The Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance requires owners to pay tenants relocation assistance in the event of an owner move-in eviction.
rules.summary: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance when evicting for owner move-in, with a standard payment of $19,413 and an additional $6,471 for qualifying households, effective January 1, 2026.
rules.effective_date_evidence: At its October 16, 2025 Special Meeting, the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026.

rules.title: Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance (2026 adjustment)
rules.quote: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
rules.summary: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance when evicting under the Ellis Act to remove property from the rental market, with a standard payment of $19,413 and an additional $6,471 for qualifying households, effective January 1, 2026.
rules.effective_date_evidence: At its October 16, 2025 Special Meeting, the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026.
